description: Recall eval E1 (docs/proposals/agent-memory-implementation.md): synthetic conversations of one project and paraphrased questions a later agent asks. Each query names the conversation that answers it. Queries avoid the conversations' distinctive words where a person would.

conversations.title: Offline after sleep
conversations.prompt: Dieter stays offline for minutes after the MacBook wakes up
conversations.tool: The tunnel kept its pre-sleep deadline: monotonic time stops during sleep, so the reconnect timer fired late.
conversations.answer: Root cause: the gateway tunnel's reconnect deadline used the monotonic clock, which pauses while the Mac sleeps. Fix: compare wall clock time on SystemWoke and redial at once.

conversations.title: Claude turns fail with 401
conversations.prompt: Claude turns fail with authentication_error 401 roughly every eight hours
conversations.tool: OAuth access token expired at the 8 h boundary while two processes refreshed at once; one refresh token was rotated away.
conversations.answer: Two refreshers raced on the same Claude login. Claude Code must be the only refresher; the runner now resumes the session once after a 401.

conversations.title: Transcript jumps while streaming
conversations.prompt: The Mac chat view jumps to the top when new chunks stream in
conversations.tool: SwiftUI ScrollViewReader re-anchors on every layout pass.
conversations.answer: Scroll position is now owned by a native NSScrollView controller instead of SwiftUI, so streaming no longer moves the viewport.

conversations.title: CI fails without sign-off
conversations.prompt: The pull request check fails with a DCO error
conversations.answer: Every commit needs Signed-off-by; commit with -s through the hooks, never --no-verify.

conversations.title: Android flows hang on the emulator
conversations.prompt: Maestro Android flows hang at launch on the warm emulator
conversations.tool: System UI isn't responding dialog covers the app.
conversations.answer: Tap Wait on the System UI dialog with uiautomator and force-stop only the E2E app; never wipe the emulator.

conversations.title: Usage window shows 0%
conversations.prompt: Settings shows 0% usage left although the plan has plenty
conversations.tool: The usage probe parsed seven_day_opus as the session window.
conversations.answer: The probe now maps five_hour to the session window and ignores model-specific windows.

conversations.title: Search misses camelCase names
conversations.prompt: Searching for scroll controller does not find TranscriptScrollController
conversations.tool: unicode61 keeps camelCase identifiers as one token.
conversations.answer: Identifiers are split into words in a separate terms column, so parts of camelCase and snake_case names match.

conversations.title: Stable promotion stuck
conversations.prompt: The stable release waits forever in the release workflow
conversations.tool: The environment protection rule needs an approval from the owner.
conversations.answer: Stable promotion runs release.yml with channel=stable and waits for the owner's approval of the stable environment; never rename release.yml.

conversations.title: Builds fail: no space left
conversations.prompt: Gradle and Xcode builds fail with no space left on device
conversations.tool: worktree build outputs 31 GB, old harness runtimes 14 GB
conversations.answer: Deleted worktree build outputs and unpruned harness runtimes; keep the current runtime digest.

conversations.title: File transfer slow over relay
conversations.prompt: Copying files to another machine is ten times slower over the relay
conversations.tool: 16-frame window and 64 KiB stream buffer cap throughput at 3 MB/s.
conversations.answer: Raised the WebRTC window and the gateway stream buffer and pipelined chunks; throughput went from 3 to 28 MB/s.

conversations.title: Inbox stale after background
conversations.prompt: The phone Inbox stays stale after the app comes back from background
conversations.tool: A dead pooled OkHttp connection was reused.
conversations.answer: Each session renews its connections when the app returns to the foreground; a refreshing indicator shows on the Inbox.

conversations.title: Vault secret visible in transcript
conversations.prompt: A revealed vault password showed up in the conversation
conversations.tool: The reveal output was stored before redaction.
conversations.answer: Vault values are redacted before transcripts are written; reveals go only to the tool output, never the stored text.

conversations.title: Pins do not sync from the phone
conversations.prompt: Pinning a chat on the phone never reaches the Mac
conversations.tool: The first machine lagged behind and held invalid provenance pages.
conversations.answer: Records with invalid provenance are held instead of stalling the page; the lagging replica catches up.

conversations.title: Quick titles never change
conversations.prompt: New cards keep their fallback title
conversations.tool: Codex rejects injected-token turns without a global model_provider.
conversations.answer: The Codex home declares agent_bridge_openai globally, so quick title turns succeed again.

conversations.title: Navigation bar redraws constantly
conversations.prompt: The Android glass navigation bar burns CPU while idle
conversations.tool: The blur layer invalidated itself every frame.
conversations.answer: The glass effect now redraws only when content behind it scrolls.

conversations.title: Codex shows Reconnecting and fails
conversations.prompt: Codex turns end as failed after Reconnecting... although the answer arrived
conversations.tool: A transient reconnect notice was treated as a terminal error.
conversations.answer: Reconnecting notices are informational; the turn fails only when the stream ends without a result.
